title: Last chance to save up to $200 on your TechCrunch Founder Summit pass: Early booking ends October 16
summary: Savings of up to $200 end October 16 for TechCrunch Founder Summit. These savings for Founder and Investor Passes vanish after Friday. Join 1,000 founders and investors on November 4 at Boston’s SoWa Power Station. Bring your toughest questions and make the day count for your bus
reason: Promotional event-ticket discount for TechCrunch Founder Summit. No AI model release, research artifact, industry business event, policy action, or open-source tool announced; no rule covers it.
